Atlas main 0.3.19 (boundless-atlas 91f004e), asi d09ee22f, oop plugin 08f6bb06, script half atlas-main18-1127. atlas-tile-pager-1126: Boundless Atlas docs/044 TP-4, the terrain tile pager on the 8192 m strip world, pager on vs off. NOT RUN, dry-run only (2026-11-26). Needs (1) AtlasStrip_8192.world installed as for atlas-8192-load-strip-8192; (2) Bin state apex-oop-atlas set by the chain as in the atlas-oop-1126 queue note, but with game-copy/atlas-main11/atlas-oop.dll (sha256 d33367ece6b131ec9f3c274bfc3d846c1fc05ef2ba1e4263393ac28efdacb30b, protocol 4) copied into game-copy/apex-oop-test instead of the atlas-main5 dll; check its sha256 before the run and restore with collect afterwards. Both arms run the same atlas.asi build (the off arm is TilePager=2: EA's code, only the threshold search hashed), so the only difference is where the optimizer copy lives. Exactness: the last 'atlas:tiles thresholds (...)' line of each arm, equal hash and count. Memory: diag: mem big= at the tp-* marks (HS-1 marks reused). One job at a time, off arm first. Household rule: no household is active; the pager changes no Sim (docs/044 §2.4). TP-6 (2026-11-27): the queue is repinned to the TP-6 build (feature/terrain-tile-pager-1126 28d922e, game-copy/atlas-tp6-1126: atlas.asi and the protocol 4 atlas-oop.dll, one dll for all four jobs) and two paint jobs follow the tile jobs: paint off (PaintPager=2, readers and loader hooked, hashed, nothing paged) then paint on (PaintPager=1, the paint blocks in the host, 8 MB block cache), TilePager=0 in both. Read (Boundless Atlas docs/044 §8.8): the on arm's 'atlas:paint load gen' line (absent = the map loaded before the store gate, G-489); big= at tp-loaded and tp-live about 130 MB above the off arm = the blocks left the process; fill p99 in the summary under 2 ms; P4 count and hash of the first 'atlas:paint hash (load)' or '(periodic)' line equal across arms = exact load-time reads; P1-P3 counts depend on camera timing, so unequal counts there are inconclusive, not a failure. TP-5 (2026-11-27): repinned to the rebased 0.3.14 build (Boundless Atlas feature/terrain-tile-pager-1126 e23bae3 on main 953ffc8, game-copy/atlas-main11, mod set atlas-main11) and three height jobs follow the paint jobs, all with TilePager=0 and PaintPager=0: heights off (HeightPager=0, HeightShapeGuard=0: the off line), guard only (HeightShapeGuard=1: the EA fix of docs/044 §9.6 alone), heights on (HeightPager=1 with the guard). Read (docs/044 §9.7, §9.8): big= at tp-loaded and tp-live against the off arm (the main map and the water grid copy, 134.3 MB each at 8192 m, are transient: expect the difference at the load peak, not in play); the on arm's 'atlas:heights load gen' lines (absent = the repro never loaded a height map in a section); the world-quit summary: refused 0, faults 0, bugs 0, view failures 0; load time against the off arm (G-493, the water grid build reads through the dispatcher); 'atlas:hshape parked' lines in the guard arms = the EA use-after-free case happened and was held.
